Addressed: No fixes were applied. The merge reached the required stop condition.

There are no reviews or pre-review comments on head `4acc5ec0e3d794d42e0ecab4e9017332ad8507f0`.

I attempted to merge upstream main `db3bb1f7f3c47cf3561a8e9534f4f2cde260cba8`. Both branches change the same logic:

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, `run_job_arms`, conflict lines 326–354: the PR routes Chamfer selections and refuses Boundary settings for open chamfer runs. Main changes the same `contour_sel_arm` predicate to include sketch contours.
- `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`, `collect_job`, conflict lines 269–312 and 324–341: the PR excludes Chamfer selections from region generation. Main adds sketch contour and slot routing, Waterjet selections, and sketch guards in the same dispatch.

The requested conflict rule requires a stop when both branches change the same logic. I aborted the merge. The worktree is clean at the original head. No commit or push occurred. The warm worktree remains at `.claude/worktrees/fix-3251`.

Quick gate, heavy gate, catalog tests, mutation checks, and clippy did not run. No fix exists to test. Re-review remains blocked by these conflict hunks.

Thank you, @paulrobin. You are welcome to continue on this branch.

Addressed: the merge conflict with main. No review findings were open on head `4acc5ec0e`. The new head is `91a6a2bd5`.

Thank you, @paulrobin, for this work. With your permission for maintainer edits, I merged main into your branch. I did not rebase or force-push.

**What I did**

- Commit `fe58ff734` merges upstream main `39f834bbc` into the branch.
- Commit `f25ae726c` merges the newer main `80f1dc364`. This merge had no conflicts.
- Commit `91a6a2bd5` fixes a test that came from main.

**Hand resolutions (this refresh is a DELTA: please review the remerge-diff)**

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs`, `patched()`. I kept the two behaviours:
   - main reads back the zero wire `taper_deg` from the typed value;
   - the PR keeps a literal false or zero patch of an opt-in field (`opt_in_kept`, which replaces main's `flag_kept`).
   Main's `pass_start` `auto` branch is kept. I merged the two comments into one.
2. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs`, `chamfer_open_runs`. Main added only comments in this hunk. I kept the PR's tip-offset branch and all of its refusals:
   - the Side class that cannot be read;
   - the Side that names the wrong wall;
   - the offset that folds or disappears.
   Main's side comment and guard comment are kept. The guard index now uses `pass.len().saturating_sub(2)`. Before, a pass with fewer than two points made the subtraction overflow before the guard could refuse it.
3. Project version. Main is now at v78, so the tip offset uses **v79** (it was v74 on the PR):
   - `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`: `PROJECT_VERSION = 79`, with a v79 note after main's v74-v78 notes;
   - `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`: v78 -> v79 migration note;
   - `crates/app/tests/chamfer_minimum_radius.rs`: the legacy file is now v78, the last version without a radius;
   - `docs/decisions/3153-minimum-cone-radius.md`: "Project v79".
   `crates/app/src/project/mod.rs` takes main's text.
4. Example projects. The PR changed only the `version` line in these files, so I took main's version line in each. `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj` saves v79, because `continuous_4axis_part` requires the current version. `edge-work` and `hole-work` keep main's v73.
5. `crates/motion/tests/chamfer_open_refusals.rs` is a new file on main. It now sets `minimum_cone_radius: 0.0`, the ideal-tip path.

`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` and the routing code merged without a conflict on this main. The Chamfer arm keeps the PR's tool radius and flute reach refusals. Main's routing does not change.

**Tests on head `91a6a2bd5`**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 808 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (100 min). This includes:
  - motion: `chamfer_minimum_radius`, `chamfer_circular`, `chamfer_open_refusals`;
  - app: `chamfer_minimum_radius`, `mcp_chamfer_minimum_radius`, `chamfer_open_edges`, `chamfer_modelled_edge`, `chamfer_partly_bevelled`, `setup_align_chamfer`, `stock_chamfer_added_part`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_edge_work`;
  - `ui suites: lib`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run: the light lane and the heavy lanes. This is a P6 refresh, so no heavy step is required.

Draft state, labels and title are not changed.

Ready for a re-review.

Needs changes before merge. Five requested changes follow.

This is the first marked review. There are no earlier marked findings to resolve. I checked the refresh comment and the merge resolutions.

**What passed**

The parameter reaches the UI, commands, project files, stamps, and MCP. The positive cone-band tests pass. Tool radius and flute reach refusals pass.

**Local results**

I trial-merged the head with main `f519445d4fa816fbdf2689416910a1cd92938819`. Trial merge: `df4c2dbd93106d580dec9fc37d8426c95a19edd7`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate | 808 steps: 807 passed, 1 failed, 0 stalled; 63.6 minutes |
| Motion and app suites | All selected suites passed |
| UI integration suites | All selected suites passed |
| UI library | 1,536 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored |
| Same UI library on bare main `f519445d4` | 1,535 passed, the same 7 failed, 8 ignored |
| Clippy: motion, app, UI; all targets; warnings denied | Passed |
| Light lane | All 11 tests passed across five targets |

The seven UI failures need a graphics adapter. Six are in `egui_app::report_tests`; the seventh is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`.

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
metal found no adapters
```

Bare main has the same failures. These host failures do not block this PR. I did not identify a tracking issue.
Both new UI tests passed, including `chamfer_geometry_exposes_tip_offset`.

**Extra suites run**

- `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed. The quick gate also ran `recorded_post_streams` and `solid_law_goldens`; both passed.
- All discovered light targets ran: motion `lib`, `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`; app `pocket_pass_start`.
- Two added review probes failed on the unchanged implementation. Findings 1 and 2 give the results.

The diff changes no importer or fixture directory. The extra kernel import suites do not apply.
No PR-owned NC or CL golden changed. The example project changes only its version. Main supplied the other golden changes in the trial merge.
Full heavy lanes did not run. This P6 PR does not require them under current main's rules.

**Mutation checks**

I used a separate temporary source copy. I did not change the PR branch or the review worktree's tracked files.

1. Remove the radius from `tip_z`: `radius_two_uses_the_two_to_three_cone_band_at_z_seventeen` fails at its Z assertion.
2. Reverse the closed offset sign: `a_closed_ring_offsets_toward_the_named_side` fails at its Outside assertion.

Both mutations returned 101. After restoration, the complete motion `chamfer_minimum_radius` suite passed all five tests.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Geometry refusal class:** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs:179`. Equal loop counts do not prove that the whole selected boundary survives. An inward offset can remove a narrow branch and keep one loop. The generator then returns a partial ride and declares the original whole edge.

   Reproduction: use the polygon `(0,0), (20,0), (20,20), (12,20), (12,30), (8,30), (8,20), (0,20)`. Set Inside, tip offset 3, width 1, angle 45, and top Z 20. Generation returns `Ok`. The axis reaches only `Y=17.769549`. The outer cone radius is 4, so it cannot reach the selected edge at `Y=30`. The returned `EdgeBreak` still contains that edge.

   Check the complete boundary after each offset. Refuse every lost span, including a partial collapse that preserves the loop count. Add this case to the refusal tests.

2. **Zero compatibility class:** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs:221` and `:367`. The new `break_depth()` changes zero-offset `Toolpath` bytes. With width 1, angle 45, and top Z 20, the legacy depth is `1.0`. The new depth is `0.9999999999999999`. Their bit values are `4607182418800017408` and `4607182418800017407`.

   Keep the legacy depth calculation on both zero-offset routes. Compare the complete result against a captured legacy result. The current migration test generates both compared paths with the new implementation.

3. **UI evidence class:** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:173`. The body has no before/after screenshots for the added control and changed height note. Add those links to the body. Store screenshots only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

4. **Test placement class:** `crates/app/tests/chamfer_minimum_radius.rs:1`, `crates/app/tests/mcp_chamfer_minimum_radius.rs:1`, and `crates/motion/tests/chamfer_minimum_radius.rs:1`. Current main requires new tests to join domain directory suites. Move these tests into such suites, or give a one-line reason for each new binary in the body. These files are not isolated-suite exemptions.

5. **Versioning class:** `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:181`. Version 79 makes saved files unreadable by version 78 readers. The commits and PR title have no breaking-change marker. Record the format change with `!` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` commit footer, as the project law requires. Update the body from version 74 to version 79.

**Optional, non-blocking**

`crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs:309`: the refusal recommends Side Auto. Auto maps to Outside, so it cannot resolve an Inside hole-wall mismatch. Name the required explicit Side in this message.

The warm worktree and `review-3251` branch remain in place. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Please re-review this head.

Delta review of the refresh merge `0a2c39ee5`. Needs one change before merge: 1 NEW blocker.

The earlier review of `613588b` was clean. This review reads only `git show --remerge-diff 0a2c39ee5` (class DELTA) and the trial merge with the current `main`. This is a safety-tier PR (Chamfer toolpath and project format).

**NEW blocker: the PR does not compile with the current `main`**

1. `crates/app/tests/chamfer_minimum_radius.rs:24` - `error[E0063]: missing field 'form' in initializer of 'camcraft_app::tools::Tool'`.
   - #3369 (form mill presets, merge `d3c2bf0ba`) merged to `main` after the refresh base `ddee3aed6`. It adds the field `Tool::form`.
   - The `taper()` helper in this file builds a full `Tool` literal. The refresh added `tip_diameter` and `tip_form` but not `form`, because `form` was not on `main` at that time. The earlier review could not see this break.
   - Fix: merge `main` again and add `form: None,` to the literal. `crates/app/tests/mill2d_b.rs:326` shows the same edit that #3369 made.
   - Text merge with `main` `d3c2bf0ba` is clean (`git merge-tree`). Only this compile error stops it.

**Delta checks: all correct**

1. **Project version 79 -> 80, against the #3368 tip-form step.** I read `file.rs` and `apply.rs` at the new head.
   - `PROJECT_VERSION = 80`, `TIP_FORM_PROJECT_VERSION = 79`. The const assert `PROJECT_VERSION != TIP_FORM_PROJECT_VERSION` holds.
   - Written version: `written_project_version(true)` is `max(80, 79) = 80`. A file without a tip form also writes 80. Every save writes v80.
   - Old v79 tip-form file: `tip_form_read_version(79)` now returns 79, because `79 > 80` is false. Version 79 enters the `(53..=PROJECT_VERSION)` ladder and steps to 80. The tip keys use `#[serde(default)]` and read at all versions.
   - I checked every version gate in `crates/app/src/project` (`from < 60/68/76`, `from >= 52/54/59/69`). Each gate gives the same result for `from = 78` and `from = 79`. Thus a v79 file opens as a v78 file did before.
   - Newer file: `NEWEST_PROJECT_VERSION` is 80. A v81 file does not enter the ladder and gets `UnsupportedVersion`.
   - A v79 reader refuses a v80 file. This is the intended break. The `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer and the decision note say v80.
2. **`opt_in_kept` in `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:176`.** A boolean field must come back `true`, as `main`'s strict check asks. A number field probes `1.0` and must come back. `probe_kept` still has its two callers (`corner_relief`, `pass_start`). The call site at line 111 passes `v.is_boolean()`. Correct.
3. **#3368 test in `crates/app/tests/project_roundtrip.rs`.** The removed const assert (`TIP_FORM_PROJECT_VERSION > PROJECT_VERSION`) would not compile at v80. The removal is necessary. The new asserts check the written version and that it is at least the tip-form version. The open of the saved file and the tool comparison stay.
4. `heights_note_tests.rs` and `chamfer_minimum_radius.rs` take `picks: Default::default()`. The 4-axis example and the decision note say v80. Correct.

**Local results**

|---|---|
| Trial merge of `0a2c39ee5` with `main` `d3c2bf0ba` | Clean text merge, `3c741a7de` |
| `cargo check -p camcraft-app --tests` on the trial merge | **Failed**: 1 error, E0063 above |
